description: Run, stop and debug Spring Boot apps in multi-module Maven workspaces: reactor-aware, profile/port memory, port conflict detection, runtime monitoring and JaCoCo coverage
view.apps.name: Spring Boot Apps
view.apps.welcome:
No Spring Boot apps found.
Make sure the workspace root contains pom.xml, then click refresh.
[Rescan](command:webBoot.refresh)
command.edit: Edit Profile / Port / Main Class / -am / Coverage...
config.mavenCommand: Maven executable. On Windows this can be `mvn` (the extension appends `.cmd` automatically) or an absolute path.
config.preBuild.compile: Run mvn compile before launching (default; fast and catches compile errors)
config.preBuild.install: Run mvn install before launching (needed when dependency modules are consumed by other projects)
config.buildDependencies: Whether to append `-am` to `mvn -pl :module` when launching inside the reactor (also builds dependency modules). When disabled, only the target module is built; its dependencies must already be installed in the local repository (for example, run `mvn install -DskipTests` first).
config.monitor: After the app starts, collect runtime status every 5 seconds: read JVM heap and GC via `jstat`, probe Tomcat liveness and response time over HTTP; if the app exposes Actuator, also show the Tomcat thread pool. Results appear in tree nodes and tooltips.
config.debugPort: Debug port (JDWP). If occupied, the next free port is used automatically.
config.runner.description: How the launched process is hosted.
config.runner.outputChannel: Run in the "Web Boot" output channel; startup completion detection and precise stop are available
config.runner.terminal: Run in the integrated terminal for manual input, but startup completion cannot be detected
config.autoAttach: When debugging, automatically attach to the JDWP port after the app starts.
config.autoOpen: Automatically open the app URL in the browser after it starts.
config.javaHome: Override JAVA_HOME for the launched process. Leave empty to inherit JAVA_HOME from the current environment.
config.extraArgs: Extra JVM arguments appended to spring-boot:run (one per item, e.g. -Xmx2g).
config.coverage: Attach the JaCoCo agent to `spring-boot:run` on start (tcpserver mode): when stopping or sampling manually, execution data is dumped before the process ends, accumulated and merged across runs, then an HTML + XML coverage report is generated. Not available in terminal mode (`webBoot.runner = terminal`).
config.coveragePort: JaCoCo agent tcpserver port. If occupied, the next free port is used automatically.
config.coverageJacocoVersion: JaCoCo version (agent and CLI). On first use it is downloaded to the local repository via mvn dependency:get and cached under .vscode/web-boot/jacoco/.
config.language.description: UI language. auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
